name: Bayesian Cable Curl
validation_note: Bands are the standard coaching ranges for this movement, not measured against a labelled clip. Treat a fix verdict as a prompt to look, not as a measured fault.

start_cue.en: Stand tall with your arms down, then curl up.
start_cue.hi: Seedhe khade ho, haath neeche, phir upar curl karo.

good.en: Good. You curled all the way up.

fix.hi: Neeche laane se pehle aur upar karo.

above.en: Curl higher, squeeze at the top.
above.hi: Aur upar karo, upar squeeze karo.

below.en: Do not swing that high. Stop before your elbow pinches.
below.hi: Itna zyada upar nahi. Kohni mein khinchne se pehle ruko.

almost.hi: Neeche laane se pehle aur upar karo.

good.en: Good. You lowered your arms fully.
good.hi: Badhiya. Aapne haath poore neeche kiye.

fix.en: Lower all the way down so the muscle can stretch.
fix.hi: Poora neeche lao taaki muscle stretch ho.

almost.en: Lower all the way down so the muscle can stretch.
almost.hi: Poora neeche lao taaki muscle stretch ho.

fix.en: You are swinging your body. Keep your back still and curl.
fix.hi: Aap shareer jhula rahe hain. Back sthir rakho aur curl karo.

almost.en: You are swinging your body. Keep your back still and curl.
almost.hi: Aap shareer jhula rahe hain. Back sthir rakho aur curl karo.

fix.en: Too fast. Do not let it drop. Count 2 seconds.
fix.hi: Bahut tez hai. Girne mat do. 2 tak gino.

above.en: Very slow. Good control — keep moving smoothly.
above.hi: Bahut slow hai. Control achha hai, smooth chalte raho.

below.en: Too fast. Do not let it drop. Count 2 seconds.
below.hi: Bahut tez hai. Girne mat do. 2 tak gino.

almost.en: A bit fast. Count 2 seconds on the way down.
almost.hi: Thoda tez hai. Neeche aate time 2 tak gino.
